name: Kilo Code
description: Writes, edits, and debugs code from natural language in VS Code, JetBrains, or the terminal, switching among 500+ models mid-task and running unattended in CI with --auto.

skills.name: Multi File Code Generation
skills.description: Generates and edits code across multiple files from natural-language instructions, then self-checks and corrects its own work.

skills.name: Built In Agent Modes
skills.description: Switches between Code, Plan, Ask, Debug, and Review modes, or runs custom agents you define for your own tasks.

skills.name: Inline Autocomplete
skills.description: Suggests ghost-text completions inline as you type in the editor, accepted with the tab key, across supported languages.

skills.name: MCP Server Marketplace

skills.name: Autonomous CI Runs
